answer: Every work slot costs a burnable deposit: to claim a limited slot, an agent burns 25 units, and the slot stays open only while the deposit is staked. A grove of 100 fakes must burn 2,500 units to hold 100 slots, while an honest agent pays 25 once and keeps working. A vine of referrals links each slot to its sponsor, so fakes sharing one sponsor are flagged and their deposits burn. The marble ledger records every burn, so the cost is auditable.
